title: A Bolt paid for, then countered
story: My Nether Void was already on the battlefield when my opponent pointed Lightning Bolt at me. They tapped a Mountain for its red casting cost, leaving only two untapped mana-producing lands. Nether Void then triggered above Bolt on the stack. I asked whether they could pay another three; they could not. The trigger countered Bolt before it dealt damage. On my following turn I used Mishra's Factory as a creature threat. Animating the Factory was an activated ability, not casting a spell, so Nether Void offered no extra payment for that action.
review: Opponent uses Mountain for red Bolt casting cost; trigger demands three additional mana on resolution, two available cannot pay. Nether Void does not increase printed spell cost. Mishra's Factory animation is activated ability.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
